zn2qdade.baseName: My Christmas 5ft Snow Flocked Artificial Christmas Tree with 532 Tips - White
zn2qdade.variantName: My Christmas 5ft Snow Flocked Artificial Christmas Tree with 532 Tips - White
zn2qdade.sourceDescription: Create a winter wonderland in your home with this snow-flocked artificial Christmas tree, featuring thick PVC branches covered in white flocking for a fresh, snowy appearance. Its full, well-spaced branches provide plenty of room for baubles, garlands and tree toppers, allowing you to personalise your festive display. Made with durable PVC foliage and a reinforced metal stand with padded feet, the tree offers reliable stability while helping protect your flooring. The segmented trunk and foldable base make assembly straightforward, while the collapsible sections allow convenient, space-saving storage after Christmas. Ideal for living rooms, lounges, offices and entryways, this tree brings seasonal charm to a variety of indoor spaces. Decorations are not included. Specifications: Made from durable, flame-retardant PVC with white snow-flocked branches and a reinforced metal stand with padded feet. Features a segmented trunk and foldable base for easy assembly and storage. Suitable for indoor Christmas decorating. Ornaments and decorations are not included. Dimensions: Height 150cm; diameter 95cm. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

nbzap8h7.baseName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine With Bag Christmas Tree
nbzap8h7.variantName: Christmas Tree World 6ft Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine With Bag Christmas Tree
nbzap8h7.sourceDescription: Our MD's favourite! With a classic upturned shape and incorporating super lifelike PE plastic moulded branch tips, we love the final look of this 6ft pre-lit Christmas tree. The Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine's curved outer branches not only provide an eye-catching silhouette but they also create plenty of space to hang pretty Christmas tree decorations. Our customers love how full and bushy the Pre-Lit Ultra Mountain Pine looks year after year. It is also one of our easiest 6ft Christmas trees to erect. That's thanks to the hinged and contoured branches that effortlessly fall into place (you just need to tweak the inner branches a little to fill the gaps) and the ready-lit branches. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 6ft • 500 professionally hand strung multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 1972 PE/PVC branch tips • Tree width: 120cm diameter • Foliage colour: Dark green • Realistic look: A mix of ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips, with traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • Eligible for European shipping • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

vwa6fhea.variantName: My Christmas Pre-Lit Artificial Christmas Garland 2.7m - Green
vwa6fhea.sourceDescription: This 2.7 m Christmas garland is made from durable PVC with a realistic green appearance and a flexible design that can be shaped, cut or wrapped to suit different decorative arrangements. Featuring 30 warm white LED lights, it creates a welcoming festive glow and can be used around archways, staircases, fireplaces and other areas of the home. The branches can be manually spread to create a fuller appearance, while the garland can also be decorated with ribbons, coloured lights or other Christmas accessories. Suitable for Christmas, weddings, Valentine's Day and other decorative occasions. Specifications: Durable PVC construction, realistic green finish, flexible and shapeable design, can be cut to size, 30 warm white LED lights, battery operated, requires 2 AA batteries (not included), manually adjustable branches for a fuller appearance, and suitable for Christmas, weddings and Valentine's Day decorations. Dimensions: Length: 270 cm. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

x5r30bvw.variantName: Scottish Everlastings Artificial Wreath with Orange Slices - 50cm
x5r30bvw.sourceDescription: Introducing our stunning 50cm Wreath with Orange Slices! This beautiful wreath is a perfect blend of nature's charm and festive elegance. Crafted with a chunky natural twig base, it exudes a rustic appeal that will add warmth to any space. Adorned with a delightful combination of various foliage, berries, and real orange slices, this wreath brings a burst of vibrant colours to your home. The carefully arranged orange slices create a visually striking focal point, making this wreath a true standout piece. Designed to bring the essence of nature indoors, this wreath is a versatile addition to your decor. Whether hung on your front door to welcome guests or displayed on a mantel or wall, it effortlessly adds a touch of natural beauty to any setting. To create a cohesive look, this wreath can be paired with coordinating pieces from our collection. Embrace the festive spirit and elevate your decor with our matching garlands, swags, or centrepieces. Crafted with attention to detail and made to last, this wreath is a timeless investment that can be enjoyed year after year. Materials: Plant:fabric, natural, plastic, styrofoam; wreath base:iron. Bring indoors in adverse weather conditions SEL UK Ltd Frances Industrial Park, Wemyss Road, Kirkcaldy KY12XZ
